# Stockstrail

> Stockstrail is an AMFI-registered (ARN-284122) financial guidance platform in India providing honest, personalized financial planning, mutual funds SIP advisory, fixed deposits, insurance, and loan solutions.

## Core Services

- [Mutual Funds & SIPs](https://www.stockstrail.in/mutual-funds): Goal-based mutual fund investments, equity, debt, hybrid funds, and monthly SIP wealth planning.
- [Fixed Deposits](https://www.stockstrail.in/fixed-deposit): High-yield corporate and bank fixed deposits with guaranteed returns and flexible tenures.
- [Life & Health Insurance](https://www.stockstrail.in/insurance): Comprehensive term life insurance and family health protection plans.
- [Loans Against Mutual Funds (LAMF)](https://www.stockstrail.in/loan): Instant low-interest liquidity secured by mutual fund units without selling assets.
- [Risk Profile Assessment](https://www.stockstrail.in/check-risk-profile): Risk tolerance analysis to determine personalized asset allocation.
- [Open Demat Account](https://www.stockstrail.in/open-demat): Zero-brokerage and discounted demat account setup with leading Indian stockbrokers.

## Financial Calculators

- [SIP Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/sip): Monthly systematic investment plan compounding growth calculator.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/lumpsum): One-time mutual fund investment returns visualizer.
- [FD Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/fd): Fixed deposit maturity amount and quarterly compound interest calculator.
- [RD Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/rd): Recurring deposit wealth accumulation estimator.
- [EMI Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/emi): Monthly loan EMI payment and total interest amortizer.
- [Tax Calculator](https://www.stockstrail.in/calculators/tax): Income tax comparison and savings under Old and New tax regimes in India.

## Advisory & Company

- [About Stockstrail](https://www.stockstrail.in/about): Background of founder Vikrant Bhardwaj (ARN-284122), mission, and fiduciary advisory standards.
- [Book Free Advisory Call](https://www.stockstrail.in/lets-talk): Direct 1-on-1 strategy call with AMFI-registered financial advisors.
- [Commission Disclosure](https://www.stockstrail.in/commission-disclosure): Transparent AMFI distributor commission disclosures across fund categories.
- [NSE Holidays 2026](https://www.stockstrail.in/nse-holidays): Official trading calendar and clearing holidays for the National Stock Exchange of India.
- [BSE Holidays 2026](https://www.stockstrail.in/bse-holidays): Official trading calendar and clearing holidays for the Bombay Stock Exchange.
- [Stockstrail Learning Platform](https://learning.stockstrail.in): Free financial education courses, categories, and investment lessons.
